evaluation.decision: Keep PR35 as retained checkpoint. Report seed46 and seed47 treatment differences separately and together without selecting the better seed. R32 labels are exploratory and do not replace frozen666/663 references. A single new-seed result cannot establish generalization or justify automatic promotion.

scope: Both roles use the same accepted R31 eligible training labels, byte-for-byte. R32 has no training-label delta; it only supplies a clarified exploratory development reference.

All 137 training images occur once per epoch, including 13 empty scenes. Original trainer validation remains 20 images / 664 fronts; no R32 development amendments enter training or trainer validation.
Seed 47 is fixed before this run. Every numerical recipe field besides seed matches the seed 46 PR110 comparison; within seed 47 the only treatment difference is partial-box factor 1 versus 2.
Both roles start independently from the same original epoch 173 checkpoint. The four-batch candidate resource trial is discarded and never initializes either full run.
Loss implementation reuses the exact R31 criterion. Native classification, keypoint/RLE losses, normalizer and E2E branch schedule remain unchanged.
Post-augmentation target totals can vary with seed. Log their observed values and require the two roles of this pair to see the same image order and target cohorts; do not demand seed 46 totals.
The twenty development photographs have informed repeated decisions. Neither a second seed nor R32 relabeling creates an independent test of new capture sessions.
The current archived PR35 checkpoint remains selected. No automatic model promotion, seed selection, architecture search or threshold sweep is performed.

loss_weighting.interpretation: Multiply native CIoU and normalized-L1 box contributions for already-assigned partial anchors by2 in the candidate, retaining the original target-quality scores and denominator everywhere else. BCE remains exactly native for partial, full and background anchors; keypoint, RLE and kobj terms remain native. Targets without foreground assignment receive no direct weighted contribution. Post-augmentation clipping can make an otherwise two-corner source object partial.

prior_result.interpretation: A small trade-off, not a demonstrated improvement. Two of three additional R31 matches cross IoU0.50 by small margins; only010:34 is an additional frozen666match. No frozen pair5/pair10 gain. All observed partial targets were assigned one-to-one during training.

replication.interpretation_of_gate: A prospective diagnostic screen, not a statistical significance claim or a promotion rule. Seed47 success cannot erase seed46 penalties.
replication.stop_rule: If the second seed does not show a clean favorable trade-off, stop increasing partial-box weighting; retain the native training default and PR35 selected checkpoint. Report both seeds even if they disagree.
